54604-being-a-boy.title: Being a Boy
54604-being-a-boy.creator: Unknown
54604-being-a-boy.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. One of the best things in the world to be is a boy; it requires no experience, though it needs some practice to be a good one. The disadvantage of the position is that it does not last long enough; it is soon over; just as you get used to being a boy, you have to be something else, with a good deal more work to do and not half so much fun.

arxiv-1910-11160.title: Stochastic Channel-Based Federated Learning for Medical Data Privacy Preserving
arxiv-1910-11160.creator: Rulin Shao, Hongyu He, Hui Liu, Dianbo Liu
arxiv-1910-11160.description: Abstract Artificial neural network has achieved unprecedented success in the medical domain. This success depends on the availability of massive and representative datasets. However, data collection is often prevented by privacy concerns and people want to take control over their sensitive information during both training and using processes.

arxiv-2102-04540.title: Last-iterate Convergence of Decentralized Optimistic Gradient Descent/Ascent in Infinite-horizon Competitive Markov Games
arxiv-2102-04540.creator: Chen-Yu Wei, Chung-Wei Lee, Mengxiao Zhang, Haipeng Luo
arxiv-2102-04540.description: Abstract We study infinite-horizon discounted two-player zero-sum Markov games, and develop a decentralized algorithm that provably converges to the set of Nash equilibria under self-play. Our algorithm is based on running an Optimistic Gradient Descent Ascent algorithm on each state to learn the policies, with a critic that slowly learns the value of each state.

arxiv-2201-11836.title: Right large deviation principle for the top eigenvalue of the sum or product of invariant random matrices
arxiv-2201-11836.creator: Pierre Mergny, Marc Potters
arxiv-2201-11836.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Pierre Mergny, Marc Potters. In this note we study the right large deviation of the top eigenvalue (or singular value) of the sum or product of two random matrices 𝐀 \mathbf{A} and 𝐁 \mathbf{B} as their dimensions goes to infinity. The matrices 𝐀 \mathbf{A} and 𝐁 \mathbf{B} are each assumed to be taken from an invariant (or bi-invariant) ensemble with a confining potential with a possible wall beyond which no eigenvalues/singular values are allowed.

arxiv-2403-07066.title: Re-Simulation-based Self-Supervised Learning for Pre-Training Physics Foundation Models
arxiv-2403-07066.creator: P. Harris, M. Kagan, J. Krupa, B. Maier, N. Woodward
arxiv-2403-07066.description: Abstract Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) is at the core of training modern large machine learning models, providing a scheme for learning powerful representations that can be used in a variety of downstream tasks. However, SSL strategies must be adapted to the type of training data and downstream tasks required.

arxiv-2502-16042.title: Gaussianized Design Optimization for Covariate Balance in Randomized Experiments
arxiv-2502-16042.creator: Wenxuan Guo, Tengyuan Liang, Panos Toulis
arxiv-2502-16042.description: Abstract Achieving covariate balance in randomized experiments enhances the precision of treatment effect estimation. However, existing methods often require heuristic adjustments based on domain knowledge and are primarily developed for binary treatments. This paper presents Gaussianized Design Optimization, a novel framework for optimally balancing covariates in experimental design.

arxiv-2503-14225.title: On a class of nonlinear BGK-type kinetic equations with density dependent collision rates
arxiv-2503-14225.creator: Josephine Evans, Daniel Morris, Havva Yoldaş
arxiv-2503-14225.description: Abstract We consider a class of nonlinear, spatially inhomogeneous kinetic equations of BGK-type with density dependent collision rates. These equations share the same superlinearity as the Boltzmann equation, and fall into the class of run and tumble equations appearing in mathematical biology. We prove that the Cauchy problem is well-posed, and the solutions propagate Maxwellian bounds over time.

arxiv-2505-03872.title: The eROSITA Final Equatorial Depth Survey (eFEDS):
arxiv-2505-03872.creator: C. Aydar, A. Merloni, T. Dwelly, J. Comparat, M. Salvato, J. Buchner, M. Brusa, T. Liu, J. Wolf, S. F. Anderson, C. P. Andonie, F. E. Bauer, M. R. Blanton, W. N. Brandt, Y. Díaz, L. Hernández-García, D.-W. Kim, T. Miyaji, S. Morrison, B. Musiimenta, C. A. Negrete, Q. Ni, C. Ricci, D. P. Schneider, A
arxiv-2505-03872.description: Abstract We present one of the largest uniform optical spectroscopic surveys of X-ray selected sources to date that were observed as a pilot study for the Black Hole Mapper (BHM) survey. The BHM program of the Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS)-V is designed to provide optical spectra for hundreds of thousands of X-ray selected sources from the SRG/eROSITA all-sky survey.

arxiv-2509-04402.title: Learning neural representations for X-ray ptychography reconstruction with unknown probes
arxiv-2509-04402.creator: Tingyou Li, Zixin Xu, Zirui Gao, Hanfei Yan, Xiaojing Huang, Jizhou Li
arxiv-2509-04402.description: Abstract Abstract X-ray ptychography provides exceptional nanoscale resolution and is widely applied in materials science, biology, and nanotechnology. However, its full potential is constrained by the critical challenge of accurately reconstructing images when the illuminating probe is unknown. Conventional iterative methods and deep learning approaches are often suboptimal, particularly under the low-signal conditions inherent to low-dose and high-speed experiments.

britannica-1911-humane-society-royal.title: Humane Society, Royal (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-humane-society-royal.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-humane-society-royal.description: Article 'Humane Society, Royal' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 13), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. English physician, became known in 1773 for his efforts to convince the public that persons apparently dead from drowning might in many cases be resuscitated by artificial means. For a year he paid a reward out of his own pocket to any one bringing him a body rescued from the water within a reasonable time of immersion.

pmc-10571801.title: Predictors of Non-Sentinel Lymph Node Metastasis in Patients with Positive Sentinel Lymph Node in Early-Stage Cervical Cancer: A SENTICOL GROUP Study
pmc-10571801.creator: Basile Pache, Matteo Tantari, Benedetta Guani, Patrice Mathevet, Laurent Magaud, Fabrice Lecuru, Vincent Balaya
pmc-10571801.description: Simple SummaryFor lymph node staging in the early stages of cervical cancer, sentinel lymph node (SLN) assessment, instead of full pelvic lymph node dissection, decreased the postoperative morbidity compared to full pelvic lymph node dissection. Bilateral negative SLN predicts the absence of nodal metastases, but the risk factors for lymph node involvement beyond a positive SLN remain poorly described.

pmc-10709930.title: Prediction of mortality in secondary peritonitis: a prospective study comparing p-POSSUM, Mannheim Peritonitis Index, and Jabalpur Peritonitis Index
pmc-10709930.creator: Akshant Anil Pathak, Vivek Agrawal, Naveen Sharma, Karan Kumar, Chinmay Bagla, Aakash Fouzdar
pmc-10709930.description: BackgroundRisk scoring systems are required to allow accurate prognostication, compare outcomes of surgery, and allow patients to make informed decisions about their health. This prospective study compares the p-POSSUM (Portsmouth Modification to Physiological and Operative Severity Score for Enumeration of Mortality), Mannheim Peritonitis Index, and Jabalpur Peritonitis Index for their utility in predicting mortality in patients with peritonitis.

pmc-12615310.title: Investigation on the protective effects of the color stability of phycocyanin in vitro
pmc-12615310.creator: Xiyu Zhang, Xinran Li, Wenjing Zhang, Yali Li, Boxiong Wu, Haozhe Cheng, Baoguo Sun, Shuai Hao
pmc-12615310.description: Phycocyanin (PC), which is commonly extracted from marine Spirulina platensis, has been explored as a natural blue pigment for application in the food industry. As a pigment-protein complex, the color stability of phycocyanin could be easily affected by the variation of temperature and light intensity in environment, which limits its further utilization.

pmc-12750677.title: Electrocardiographic manifestations and targeted management of cardiac complications in cardiac-involved DLBCL: a retrospective case series
pmc-12750677.creator: Jen-Yu Chuang, Kuan-Ting Chen, Johnson Lin, Ken-Hong Lim, Meng-Ta Sung
pmc-12750677.description: BackgroundCardiac involvement in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is rare but often complicated by life-threatening arrhythmias, conduction disturbances, and heart failure. Electrocardiography (ECG) is essential for early recognition and guiding intervention.ObjectivesTo characterize ECG manifestations of cardiac-involved DLBCL and evaluate strategies for managing associated cardiac complications.

pmc-13061255.title: Prevalence and social determinants of breastfeeding practices in urban slums and urban non-slum areas in India: A comparative analysis
pmc-13061255.creator: Suliat Fehintola Akinwande, Chiamaka Okonkwo, Kalonde Malama, Thabani Nyoni, Kehinde Oluwatosin Akinwande
pmc-13061255.description: Understanding how the prevalence and determinants of breastfeeding practices differ between urban slum areas, where living conditions are stringent, and urban non-slum areas, which have relatively more resources, is key to context-specific interventions. We conducted a comparative analysis to investigate the prevalence of breastfeeding practices in the urban slum and urban non-slum areas of India.

pmc-13153293.title: Influence of nanofluid on performance improvement of dielectric properties and dissolved gases in oil-immersed power transformers
pmc-13153293.creator: Abdul Suboor, Aejaz Masood, Asfar Ali Khan, Shabana Urooj, Mujib Ullah Zuberi, Shakeb A Khan, Obaidur Rahman, Shaheen Parveen, Farhad Ilahi Bakhsh
pmc-13153293.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Transformer reliability is strongly governed by the condition of insulating oil; however, limited studies have directly compared real-time aged transformer oil with standardized accelerated-aged oil or evaluated nanofluid performance in aged insulation systems. This study presents a novel comparative framework that first standardizes accelerated aging by matching its dielectric behavior and fault gas signatures with real-time aged transformer oil, and subsequently evaluates the effectiveness of mineral oil-based nanofluids in mitigating aging-induced degradation.

pmc-13350658.description: BackgroundCurrent hypertension guidelines recommend either ambulatory or home blood pressure (BP) monitoring for the management of hypertension. pmc-13582013.description: Take Home MessageMagnetic resonance imaging based quantification of Gleason pattern 4/5 enables accurate long-term prediction of metastatic recurrence after radical prostatectomy. pmc-13592140.title: Positional and Temporal Changes in Endotracheal Tube Cuff Pressure in Mechanically Ventilated Intensive Care Unit Patients: A Prospective Observational Study
pmc-13592140.creator: Derful Gülen, Serpil Ekin
pmc-13592140.description: BackgroundEndotracheal tube cuff pressure may fluctuate during routine intensive care unit (ICU) care despite standard monitoring. pmc-13625536.creator: Jun Ohnuki, Kei-ichi Okazaki
pmc-13625536.description: Conformational changes in proteins are vital to their function yet remain challenging for state-of-the-art artificial intelligence, such as AlphaFold3 (AF3), to predict. uslaw-usc-t16-s5502.title: 16 U.S.C. § 5502 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t16-s5502.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s5502.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 75 (High Seas Fishing Compliance). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. As used in this chapter— (1) The term “Agreement” means the Agreement to Promote Compliance with International Conservation and Management Measures by Fishing Vessels on the High Seas, adopted by the Conference of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations on November 24.
